svg.aria-label: The revision mode of the paper skill. Boxes: Peer reviewer: the comments as a roadmap (agent); Draft writer: a patch per item (agent); Citation compliance: each claim against its source's full text, unless you said no (agent); The citation style to confirm (stop); A claim the run cannot support (stop); A reference that cannot be confirmed, only under strict (stop); Draft writer, resumed: the statements the result files do not bear out, as a patch (agent, only when needed); Peer reviewer, resumed: the re-review (agent); Script: each patch applied, the compile, the reference checks (script); Draft writer, resumed: the response letter, for referee comments (agent, only when needed); Peer reviewer, resumed: the letter checked, a verdict per point (agent, only when needed); /writing review, unless you said no; the draft writer applies what you pick (agent, only when needed); Revised draft, the rest as limitations (agent); The mode to run, for a plain request that fits two modes (stop).
